boundary_note: These records are public context signals and design responses. They do not replace an official polygon, regulatory plan, station inventory, ownership record, engineering survey, or approved regional agreement.

observations.observed_signal: Beijing's 2024 resident population was 21.832 million and the official release also records the metropolitan rail network context.
observations.design_response: Use service reliability, reuse, and time-and-user envelopes as the first planning test; do not assume future population growth or fabricate future footfall.
observations.verification_gate: Obtain official station, walking, service-coverage, and time-of-day observations before sizing or phasing any public interface.

observations.observed_signal: Haidian's 2024 statistical bulletin reports a knowledge- and service-intensive local economy, with tertiary industry accounting for 92.49% of regional GDP and a high-tech innovation base.
observations.design_response: Prioritize a research-to-street evidence chain, shared validation, public explanation, and ordinary-service value instead of an AI-only land-use district.
observations.verification_gate: Confirm existing institutions, service demand, building capacity, ownership, and operating responsibility through official or commissioned surveys.

observations.observed_signal: The public Beijing ageing report gives a current older-adult context that makes accessible, non-digital service continuity a planning requirement.
observations.design_response: Put shade, seating, legible signs, rest, human help, and physical fallback before optional AI guidance; test with older adults, disabled users, carers, and people who decline data collection.
observations.verification_gate: Run an accessibility and heat-safety walk with consent, record service discontinuities and human-help demand, and publish negative findings before expansion.

observations.observed_signal: The official public description frames the Jing-Zhang heritage park as a roughly 9 km urban-renewal and green-space system, including bridge-space and Line 13 context.
observations.design_response: Treat the heritage green spine as a version line with station-to-park handoffs, climate comfort, and public evidence interfaces; keep exact alignments and station geometry unknown until verified.
observations.verification_gate: Reconcile the current official station, right-of-way, park, heritage, road, and emergency-access datasets before any physical line is specified.

observations.observed_signal: The current public Haidian work-report context places AI, data, safety, and the local innovation belt within an ongoing district development conversation.
observations.design_response: Make the commons a translation layer between research, safe testing, public service, and accountable operations, without claiming an approved program or government endorsement.
observations.verification_gate: Map each future pilot to a confirmed responsible owner, data permission, safety review, public-service baseline, and exit decision.

observations.observed_signal: The public planning recommendation discusses Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei innovation coordination and AI / embodied-intelligence collaboration as a development direction.
observations.design_response: Offer portable problem cards, model cards, negative-result records, and maintenance handoffs to five directional interfaces; do not claim a signed partnership, data sharing, or automatic mutual recognition.
observations.verification_gate: Each interface must confirm counterpart, purpose, lawful data scope, intellectual-property terms, safety responsibility, and withdrawal path before any exchange.

regional_interfaces.counterpart_direction: 北纬社区 / AI原点社区
regional_interfaces.input_direction: resident questions, accessibility gaps, non-digital service feedback
regional_interfaces.minimum_output: de-identified problem card, human-service gap, close reason
regional_interfaces.gate: community consent; rights/privacy review; named safety and operating owner; maintenance record owner; withdrawal path; participation does not authorize deployment

regional_interfaces.minimum_output: model card, device passport, failure list, re-test condition
regional_interfaces.gate: voluntary test participation; named test owner and safety scope; intellectual-property terms; maintenance/recall record owner; withdrawal and re-test path; no automatic result recognition

regional_interfaces.minimum_output: calibration note, uncertainty statement, independent-review question
regional_interfaces.gate: confirmed permission/consent; professional safety responsibility; rights and intellectual-property terms; maintenance handoff owner; withdrawal and no-assumed-access path

regional_interfaces.input_direction: engineering, manufacturing, supply-chain, and product-maintenance questions
regional_interfaces.minimum_output: interoperability evidence, maintenance requirement, stop / recall condition
regional_interfaces.gate: voluntary participation; product-safety and consumer-rights review; named maintenance/recall owner; withdrawal path; no procurement claim

regional_interfaces.input_direction: cross-city common problems and portable governance methods
regional_interfaces.minimum_output: location-agnostic schema, negative result, version difference, maintenance handoff
regional_interfaces.gate: local consent and legal, safety, and operating review in each jurisdiction; rights/IP and maintenance handoff; withdrawal and no-recognition path; no copying of coordinates or personal data
